message: 一仕事
The dance party. 45 minutes until doors open.

name: Synn
message: 「That wraps up the inspection.」

name: Ria
message: 「We managed to pull it off.」

name: Synn
message: 「It's all thanks to everyone.」

name: Misa
message: 「Naturally, considering I'm the vice president.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Now if Lolo-chan and the others can just handle their end, everything'll be set.」
The magic circle in the plaza still hasn't been completely dispelled.
Even now, Lolotte, Melilot-san, and Amyrina are hard at work on it.

name: Synn
message: 「Still, it's lost 70% of its function, so the world won't suddenly end.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Meaning we've got time to dance?」

name: Synn
message: 「We'll have to make sure we have time after that, too.」
Both the dance party venue and the booths for the wind ensemble and choir were awaiting the arrival of tonight's stars.
Before that, though.

name: Synn
message: 「Misa.」

name: Misa
message: 「What is it.」

name: Synn
message: 「I have a quick errand to run, so keep an eye on things while I'm gone.」

name: Misa
message: 「Huh? The dance party is about to start! The wind ensemble and choir still have their rehearsals, too! How could the person in charge just wander off!」

name: Synn
message: 「That's exactly why I have to go--to make sure the dance party is a success.」

name: Misa
message: 「All the more reason you should be staying right here!」

name: Synn
message: 「I've got one quick job to do.」

name: Ria
message: 「Could it be... because you're the Demon Lord?」
Granting Bylous's wish. That is an act befitting the Demon Lord.
However.

name: Synn
message: 「No, it's so I can enjoy a sparkling school life.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, just the usual, then.」

name: Ria
message: 「In that case, have a safe trip.」

name: Misa
message: 「Big Sister!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「My Ria-chan really gets it!」

name: Synn
message: 「Alright, Misa! I'm leaving things to you for a little while.」

name: Misa
message: 「You don't have to tell me.」

name: Ria
message: 「It'll be okay.」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I'm not worried or anything!」

name: Ria
message: 「After all, the Demon Lord--no, Synn-kun is a splendid Student Council President. He'll fulfill his duties as the one in charge properly.」
40 minutes before admission begins.

name: Melphas
message: 「Mr. Student Council President. Right on time, I see.」

name: Bylous
message: 「Since ancient times, a worthy Demon Lord never breaks a promise.」

name: Melphas
message: 「Though if it were a date with a lady, arriving 30 minutes before the appointed time would be a man's duty.」
The battle against Bylous. Melphas is the witness.

name: Paqy
message: 「I'm here too, you know!」
I transformed.
Power swelled endlessly inside my body, and my five senses expanded.
Overwhelmed by the sheer expansion of my perception, my consciousness was momentarily struck by something akin to dizziness, and once it subsided.
I was the Demon Lord.
The cheerful bustle filling the academy echoed as if from within me.
I could tell everyone was enjoying the Holy Night Festival, reluctant to see its end draw near yet looking forward to the final dance party.
Protecting the world, the Human World, Heaven, the Demon World--things like that are too vast for me to grasp.
But when it comes to protecting them, I understand it instinctively. It reaches my heart.
What I'm protecting is our sparkling school life. That's enough for me.
Most likely, all the past Demon Kings felt the exact same way.

name: Bylous
message: 「Now, Re-Crea is at its critical threshold as well. Truly, you are the strongest Demon Lord.」
The instant Bylous muttered that with genuine delight.
His figure swelled outward with a sudden surge.
Space itself shimmered from the immense wave of demonic power.
I felt the magic power he had been concealing spread out like wings of darkness.
It wasn't quite on the level of Re-Crea, which I had faced only once, but he was in a completely different league from Soltia.
I surpassed him in raw power, yet he was a battle-hardened warrior. The gap in experience was massive.

name: Melphas
message: 「By the way, how much time remains until the dance begins?」

name: Synn
message: 「40 minutes. I'll finish this before then.」
I tried saying it provocatively.
It'd be easy if he were the type to lose his cool over something like that, though.

name: Melphas
message: 「I see. Dancing with the opposite sex is nectar for the soul. After all, nothing else can quite replace it.」

name: Bylous
message: 「If you can actually end it, that is.」
Bylous was simply enjoying the situation.
He isn't the type to fall for provocations.
I looked straight into his eyes and spoke, almost as if reminding myself.

name: Synn
message: 「I'm ending this.」

name: Bylous
message: 「Then by all means, fulfill my long-cherished wish.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm not fighting to grant your wish.」

name: Bylous
message: 「Is it because I'm the Demon Lord?」

name: Synn
message: 「It's because I love my sparkling school life!!」
